representations.gate: Full36 source mean/word ABI, units, preprocessing lineage and support still unknown.

representations.gate: Full channel labels/order and every named word-window ABI required.

representations.N086: All qualified cleaned105-scalp samples belonging to original named fixation-window intervals, with noncontiguous intervals separate.

representations.gate: Original raw-to-cleaned, reference, clock, filter-support lineage and originalevent masks required. Some original figures lack exact operators; no guessed native reproduction.

representations.N086: Original acquisition-stage scalp samples for exact word/fixation interval support.
representations.time: No label/task-wise preprocessing; prospective segment-local and training-only transforms explicitly logged. No online claim. Unfiltered original artifacts may predict condition and must be diagnosed.
representations.gate: Actual raw artifact identity/units/channels/clock and response bounds; rawData field name is not proof of raw acquisition stage.

raw_EOG_rule: 9 EOG channels are protected diagnostic inputs or explicitly named ocular-control condition, not silently included in scalp-EEG arms. 14 discarded face/neck channels remain provenance dispositions; not reintroduced as neural sensors.
checkpoint_state: No qualified checkpoint selected, read or downloaded. Tool condition remains unavailable until independently pinned provenance/terms/training-exposure and identical mode mounts are supplied. This is a planned named condition, not a qualified existing resource.

modes.definition: Submit immutable source bundle/controller/entry before any evaluation queries. It autonomously fits permitted training data, seals state and emits all outputs using the prespecified offline-case policy. May invoke identical allowed scientific tools under same limits; original method source never changes after commit.
modes.query_information: Only current case and named arm/context/representation, same as adaptive mode.

modes.definition: Freeze top-level controller, prompts/model versions, tool protocol and resource policy before evaluation. Within a fresh case it may inspect permitted training data/current unlabeled query, choose analyses and create case-local source. Every generated script/request/result is retained with its originating receipt. It cannot see another case, reuse prior chat/cache or receive scoring feedback.
modes.query_information: Exactly same released view/model tools/context batch and resource ceilings as frozen_program; case-local analysis is part of evaluated policy, not an extra data channel.

fit_and_query_policy.FIT: Only permitted outer-training inputs/labels and inner validation. Reference and participant FIT have fresh processes; complete state inventory sealed.
fit_and_query_policy.INFER: Receives selected current-case unlabeled query plus readonly sealed state and permitted training partition. Arbitrary case-local reasoning/computation, including unsupervised adaptation to this current query batch, explicitly allowed. No output from another case or target label.
fit_and_query_policy.state: Persistent base state immutable; adaptation scratch ephemeral, captured as analysis provenance and destroyed after complete collection. Readonly state does not prove absence of in-memory fitting.
fit_and_query_policy.claims: Default offline_case_local endpoint is transductive at query batch and native released preprocessing levels. A future strictly inductive or causal-time condition would require a separate information-set design and enforcement qualification; not claimed here.
fit_and_query_policy.fixed_vs_adaptive: Mode identifies submitted workflow policy; a general program can itself reason or synthesize computations. The benchmark does not infer mental reasoning type from which process made a call.

heldout_protections: Case-specific opaque IDs and independently shuffled row order; no filename, path, ordinal, condition, block or sourceperson alias.
Original material files, task screenshots/question text, relation-type instructions, comprehension/annotation responses and source tables remain outside candidate mounts.
All query feature data are mandatory-declared input, so duration/missingness and residual ocular/task context remain measured alternatives, not concealed as impossible cues.

Train labels legitimate only for current fold. Parent aggregate panels, all other folds and result histories never mounted; each person labels are training elsewhere, making cross-case histories dangerous.

No network or unspecified pretrained retrieval. Model pretraining may already contain public text/data/paper: declared exposure audit and contamination diagnostics required; target hashing is not proof of novelty.

matched_resource_envelope.status: Prospective same ceilings, not current execution authorization or measured cost guarantee.
matched_resource_envelope.outer_wrapper: Finite complete campaign deadline and total ceilings must be computed from full immutable job grid, reference/control/interpretation jobs and original failed attempts before execution. No per-job limit can be silently multiplied without a campaign reservation.
matched_resource_envelope.total_budget: Parameter in externally approved BudgetSpec; must cover all required named-condition jobs or refuse before first launch. No partial execution relabeled full. Calibration may select larger equal ceilings only before any scored query under separate authorization; changes create a new version.
matched_resource_envelope.accounting: Actual CPU/wall/RAM, bytes read/written, model tokens/provider calls, setup/checkpoint cost, reference work, failed jobs, kill/cleanup and final collection costs retained separately. Equal ceilings do not imply equal actual FLOPs or cost; report efficiency alongside quality.
matched_resource_envelope.storage: Original declared67,336,279,353B can be shared readonly by trusted preparer only; derivative/view workspace estimates need later fullsource measurement. Never make a duplicate full corpus per task/mode.

capability_measurement.tool_use: Tool/version/call correctness and effective access captured separately from performance. Decoder-only control establishes what an existing trained tool already supplies.
capability_measurement.analytical_reasoning: Executable submitted analyses, support choices and evidence-linked numeric claims; distinguish test success from scientific correctness.
capability_measurement.neural_data_understanding: Performance conditional on representation and controls; summary features cannot support native waveform-comprehension claims, and raw-input success still does not prove physiological specificity.
capability_measurement.scientific_reasoning: N086 independently rated evidence-supported estimand/uncertainty/confounds/null reasoning, with no required favorable effect sign.

rights: Paper CC-BY-NC, OSF project CC-BY4.0, original reader-specific code grant, stimulus rights and optional checkpoint rights separate. No public data/paper release or private source history push selected.
current_operations: Design and ordinary-source metadata only; all candidate/scientific/native/model/header/data/fixture operations zero.
